messages:
Maya: Quick design sync — thinking about a compact left rail that nests Models, Datasets, Embeddings under one parent (working label: 'Library'). Primary constraints: preserve shared links, predictable keyboard flow, and breadcrumb semantics.

Omar: +1 on consolidation. We must avoid breaking links folks paste in support threads. Proposal: client-side canonicalization where old routes are accepted but replaced with `/library/...` via replaceState so users see the new URL without polluting history.

Keisha: On naming: tests showed 'Library' felt friendly but some PMs worried it implies docs. What about 'Data Library' as a compromise? Also add a tiny subtitle under the parent: "Models · Datasets · Embeddings" for clarity.

Eli: Accessibility checklist thoughts: 1) keep skip-to-content anchors valid after any client rewrite; 2) implement roving tabindex for arrow-key nav inside the nested group; 3) add aria-current="page" on the active leaf; 4) when a permalink opens a panel, focus the panel header and set a polite live region update (we use `#status-msg` in other places).

Maya: Nice. On scroll: users expect the rail to remember position when switching between siblings. I suggest persisting left-rail scrollTop keyed by cluster id in a tiny client map and restoring it on enter. Browser scrollRestoration is too flaky for our SPA.

Jonah: Link strategy: short-term = hash/query snapshot like `#/library/models?id=xyz&panel=insights` so we can ship without a backend. Long-term = shortlink service `/s/abcd12` that stores a snapshot server-side for nicer copy/paste and smaller URLs. Shortlink infra needs DB + ACL checks.

Omar: Implementation note: router alias table example: `const aliases = {'/models':'/library/models','/datasets':'/library/datasets'}` then `beforeEach` do a replace. That preserves back-button semantics.

Eli: Extra a11y nuance: when restoring a permalink with state (filters, open pane), call `panelHeading.focus({preventScroll:true})` then `document.getElementById('status-msg').textContent = 'Opened panel: Insights'` so screen readers receive context. Also ensure tab order moves from rail -> main content, not trapped.

Keisha: Breadcrumb policy: prefer `Workspace > [Library] > Item` where the breadcrumb link preserves the minimal filter necessary (e.g., owner:me) but avoid pushing full filter query strings into anchor hrefs. Consider issuing a short snapshot token for complex filters.

Maya: Action items: Omar -> prototype client alias + scroll map. Eli -> a11y checklist + SR test steps for permalink flows. Jonah -> shortlink infra estimate and an interim doc for hash/query encoding. Keisha -> finalize the parent label and subtitle copy. I'll assemble mocks and a rollout note.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: D-11002 "Left rail: library grouping, permalinks, keyboard & a11y" (assignee: Maya). :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks — will post PNG mocks and a short walkthrough video in the channel later today.
